test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. 

All ears

options.text: To wait eagerly for some news
To ask a person to repeat something
To not be interested in what is being said
To talk when someone is speaking

solution:
TB Solution:

The correct answer is** 'To wait eagerly for some news.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• '**All ears****'** means **Eager to hear something, listening attentively**.

 -Example: Everyone on the plane was **all ears** when the pilot said we had to make an emergency landing.

 
• Marked option **'****To wait eagerly for some news****'** means **very keen to do something or enthusiastic about something that will happen.**

 
• So it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the idiom **'All ears'** is **'to wait eagerly for some news.'**

 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
